item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 10
item.description: Qu Ji had transferred schools. Ji Yao heard this from Xu Xingxing, who was widely known as a well-connected know-it-all—he knew everything that happened in the entire school. Xu Xingxing also said that Qu Ji’s father had been arrested for hit-and-run, and Qu Ting had been taken in for malicious retaliation and involvement in a high-value theft. Xu Xingxing took a big gulp of water before continuing, “Their family really doesn’t have a single decent person. Qu Ji isn’t any good either. If he weren’t a minor, he’d have been taken in too. I heard his mother isn’t easy to get along with either. item.title: After the Pretty Little Blind Girl Was Pampered — Chapter 9
item.description: With no classes on Sunday and his vocal teacher taking a leave, canceling the interest class, Ji Yao didn’t have to go anywhere. Yet, early in the morning, Xie Congxiao still pulled him out from under the blankets and carried him to the bathroom to wash up. Ji Yao was so sleepy he couldn’t open his eyes. He opened his mouth and let his brother brush his teeth for him, listening to Xie Congxiao’s gentle voice beside his ear: “You can go back to sleep after breakfast.” After rinsing his mouth, Ji Yao buried his face in Xie Congxiao’s chest, mumbling, “I’m not hungry yet.
